ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.3 is an AI stutter-reduction playtest for RimWorld 1.5. It keeps the validated eight-worker runtime and targets the measured JobGiver - GenClosest - Reachability/RegionTraverser long-tail chain. Per-Pawn reachability profiles are now generation-owned instead of expiring every 180 frames: a 900-frame soft refresh keeps the old validated profile available while Region.Allows capture is spread across frame-budgeted chunks, with a 3600-frame defensive hard-age fuse. Sampled positive and negative reachability authority, per-profile cooldown and the global parity fuse remain active. The low-yield identity-keyed async candidate plan and permissive RegionHint builder are retired from the active patch chain; the persistent spatial map fabric remains the foundation for JobGiver candidate reuse. Path worker results remain shadow-only. Workers do not create Jobs, reserve targets, or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map/Unity state.
